findings.title: Fallback locales are only loaded inside ApplicationController
findings.body: `I18n.translate` in translate_accelerator.rb lazily loads only `config.locale`. The fallback locales (site default and :en) are loaded only by `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!`, which is called solely from `ApplicationController#set_locale`. Sidekiq jobs, mailers, rake tasks, and any controller that skips `set_locale` run with only the current locale loaded. When that locale lacks a key, the Fallbacks module tries locales whose translations were never loaded. The result is 'translation missing' text instead of the English fallback. The fallback chain should be loaded inside `translate` / `load_locale` itself, not in one controller filter.

findings.title: LRU cache key ignores the fallback chain (multisite and default_locale changes)
findings.body: The cache key is `key + config.locale + backend.object_id`. With fallbacks, the resolved string also depends on `SiteSetting.default_locale`, which differs per site in multisite and can be changed at runtime. The cache is process-wide, so a string resolved through site A's default locale is served to site B. A change of the default locale also keeps returning stale fallback values. The same applies to a 'translation missing' result cached before the fallback locales were loaded: it stays cached for the life of the process even after they load. Include the fallback chain (or the default locale) in the key, or avoid caching misses.

findings.title: Fallback list hits SiteSetting on every lookup and may mix String/Symbol locales
findings.body: `FallbackLocaleList#[]` is called by the Fallbacks backend on every non-cached translation, including every call with interpolation args, which bypasses the LRU cache. Each call reads `SiteSetting.default_locale` and allocates an array. Also, `locale` is passed through without `to_sym`. If a caller passes a String locale (e.g. `I18n.t(k, locale: 'fr')`), `uniq` will not dedupe it against the symbol, and an unconverted String ends up in the chain. Normalize with `locale.to_sym` before `uniq`.
